name: After Hours #2 — Last Train Window
description: The last car heading out of town. City lights smear into the rain and nobody claims the backpack. After Hours is a 50-piece open edition. Token 2 is unlimited: anyone can mint this loop. After Hours is a 50-piece open edition of looping lo-fi rooms. Each piece is its own unlimited ERC-1155: rain on glass, desk lamps, last trains, and the kind of quiet you can mint forever. Hand-illustrated stills, then animated into 2.4-second analog loops with grain, weather, and lamp flicker.
